column5: A number field E that is a totally imaginary quadratic extension of a totally real field E+; it has a canonical complex conjugation. In the Lean source (CMType) it also carries a fixed choice of one complex embedding for each infinite place.

column1: absolute value of a nonarchimedean local field
column5: The valuation v on the completion E_w at a finite place w, written multiplicatively with values exp(-n); integral means v(x) <= 1 and a uniformiser has v = exp(-1).
column6: completion of a field at a place; discrete valuation ring

column1: finite adele ring of a number field
column5: The restricted product of the completions E_w over the finite places w of E with respect to the rings of integers.
column6: place of a global field; completion of a field at a place

column5: An algebraic extension of a field k that is algebraically closed.
A nonconstant polynomial over a field that is not a product of two nonconstant polynomials.
An element x of a commutative monoid with x^n = 1 and x^l = 1 only if n divides l; i.e. of exact order n.

column1: roots of an irreducible polynomial over a finite field
column5: If c is irreducible of degree r over a finite field with q elements and x is a root in the algebraic closure, then the roots of c are x, x^q, ..., x^(q^(r-1)), each simple.
column6: finite field; Frobenius endomorphism; irreducible polynomial

column5: For a group G, the complex vector space C[G] with basis G and multiplication extending that of G.

column1: Minkowski's lemma on integral matrices of finite order
column5: An integral matrix of finite order congruent to 1 modulo a prime p>2 (more generally modulo an ideal of sufficiently large norm) is the identity. Unitary variant used: for the rational points Gamma of a definite unitary group of rank n over a CM field E and a level K reducing to 1 at distinct places whose norms multiply to more than (2n)^[E:Q], Gamma ∩ gKg^-1 is trivial.

On a finite-dimensional (more generally Hilbert) complex inner product space every conjugate-linear (continuous) form is y -> <y,z> for a unique vector z, the inner product being linear in the second variable.

column1: hermitian space over a CM field
column5: A finite-dimensional vector space V over a CM field E with a nondegenerate form linear in one variable, conjugate-linear in the other, with <x,y> = conj <y,x>; given by a hermitian Gram matrix J. Its signature at each infinite place is a tuple of signs. Definite means all signs +1. In the Lean source a 'space' also carries an adelic point x with x^* J x = diag(signs) at infinity and 1 at finite places (a self-dual lattice).

column1: unitary group of a hermitian space
column5: The algebraic group over the totally real subfield E+ of E whose points are the E-linear automorphisms g of V with <gx,gy> = <x,y>, i.e. g^* J g = J; with its adelic, finite adelic and rational points.
column6: hermitian space over a CM field; adele ring

column1: algebraic modular form on a definite unitary group
column5: For a definite unitary group G over E+, a function on G(A_f) with values in a finite-dimensional algebraic representation rho of G, with open stabiliser under right translation, such that f(gamma g) = rho(gamma) f(g) for rational gamma (Gross). Level K: right K-invariant. The associated scalar automorphic form is g -> <v, rho(g_inf^-1) f(g_f)>.
column6: unitary group of a hermitian space; finite adele ring of a number field; Weyl module

column5: The irreducible polynomial representation of GL_n of a given highest weight, described by a Young diagram (number of columns of each height) twisted by a power of the determinant; it has an integral basis indexed by semistandard fillings, and the matrix of g in this basis is the Schur matrix.
column6: general linear group; Young diagram; group representation

column5: A finite left-justified array of boxes with weakly decreasing row lengths; equivalently a partition. It is determined by the number of columns of each height; row p (from 0) has one box for each column of height > p.

column1: Harish-Chandra parameter of a discrete series
column5: For U(p,q), a discrete series representation is determined by its Harish-Chandra parameter lambda = highest weight of the minimal K-type data shifted by rho: a tuple of distinct numbers in (n-1)/2 + Z with a sign attached to each coordinate. For a compact group U(n) it is the highest weight plus rho = ((n-1)/2, ..., (1-n)/2). The Lean source stores 2*lambda.
column6: discrete series representation; unitary group of a hermitian space

column5: An irreducible unitary representation of a real reductive group that is a direct summand of L^2(G) (square-integrable matrix coefficients).

For a dual pair of unitary groups U(V), U(W) and a Schwartz datum phi on Hom(V,W) (with splitting characters), the theta kernel theta(omega(g,h)phi) is automorphic in both variables; the theta lift of a form f on U(V) is h -> integral over [U(V)] of theta(omega(g,h)phi) f(g) dg.
column6: Weil representation; unitary group of a hermitian space; automorphic form

column5: The (projective, made genuine by splitting characters for unitary dual pairs) representation of a dual reductive pair on the Schwartz space of a Lagrangian or on a Fock space, intertwining the Heisenberg representation. For unitary groups of hermitian spaces V, W over a CM field it acts on functions on the adelic points of Hom(V,W).
column6: Heisenberg group; Schwartz-Bruhat function; unitary group of a hermitian space

column5: The central extension of a symplectic (here: hermitian) vector space by the circle or additive group, with its unique irreducible representation of given central character (Stone-von Neumann); its operators are translations and modulations.
On a finite-dimensional vector space over a nonarchimedean local field (or finite adeles): a locally constant compactly supported complex function.
column6: finite adele ring of a number field

column1: Fock model of the Weil representation
column5: The realisation of the archimedean Weil representation on holomorphic polynomials (times a Gaussian vacuum); a polynomial P gives the Fock vector v_P, and P(d)F(0) (jet) pairs a polynomial with the Taylor series of a theta function.

column1: Schrödinger model of the Weil representation
column5: The realisation of the Weil representation at split finite places on functions of matrices over the completions; GL acts by (g,k) Psi(T) = character * Psi(k^-1 T g).
The inner product <f,g> = integral over G(F)\G(A) of conj(f) g on (square-integrable) automorphic forms.

column1: Hecke operator at a split place
column5: At a finite place w of E split over E+, U(V)(E+_v) = GL_n(E_w); T_{w,i} is the double coset operator of diag(pi,...,pi,1,...,1) with i entries pi. The Hecke polynomial is sum_i (-X)^i q^{i(i-1)/2} T_{w,i}.
column6: unitary group of a hermitian space; spherical Hecke algebra

column5: For a hermitian space Y = X + (hyperbolic planes + a line), the integral of an automorphic form on U(Y) over the Bessel subgroup R = U_unip x U(X) against a generic character of the unipotent part times a form on U(X) (Gan-Gross-Prasad).
column6: unitary group of a hermitian space; automorphic form

column5: The subgroup of GL_n of matrices fixing a given nonzero vector (here: last column equal to the last basis vector); here used for integral matrices modulo N.

A continuous character of the idele class group of a number field. Here: characters of U(1)(A)/U(1)(E+) (norm-one ideles of E), with a weight (an integer exponent at each infinite place) and a tame part (characters of residue fields); base change x -> nu(x / conj x) gives a Hecke character of E.
A generator of the maximal ideal of a discrete valuation ring.

column1: branching rule from GL_n to GL_(n-1)
column5: The restriction of the irreducible representation of GL_n of highest weight mu to GL_(n-1) is the multiplicity-free sum over the highest weights mu' interlacing mu: mu_1 >= mu'_1 >= mu_2 >= ... >= mu'_(n-1) >= mu_n. Integral version used: an integer matrix between Weyl modules equivariant up to the character z^(|mu|-|mu'|).
For an irreducible unitary representation rho of a compact group of dimension d and vectors u,v,u',v': integral of <rho(g)u,v> conj<rho(g)u',v'> dg = <u,u'> conj<v,v'> / d.

column1: theta correspondence for discrete series of unitary groups
column5: For a dual pair U(p,q) x U(p',q') the theta lift of a discrete series with Harish-Chandra parameter lambda (sufficiently regular) is a discrete series whose parameter is obtained from the shifted lambda by adding a block centred at 0, with signs kept for positive and reversed for negative entries (Li, Paul). Stated in the Lean source as the 'block rule' with a gap hypothesis 500(n+n')^3.
column6: Harish-Chandra parameter of a discrete series; theta lift

column5: For pairwise coprime ideals I_1,...,I_k of a commutative ring R, R / (I_1...I_k) is isomorphic to the product of the R / I_j.
The integral of exp(-|y|^2 / a) over C^n with respect to Lebesgue measure divided by pi^n equals a^n for a > 0.
For a field of characteristic p (or an extension of F_q), the map x -> x^p (resp. x -> x^q); it generates the Galois group of a finite extension of finite fields.

column1: multiplicative character of a finite field
column5: A group homomorphism from the units of a finite field k to C^x, extended by 0 at 0. The group of such characters is (non-canonically) isomorphic to k^x.

column1: Green's characters of GL_n over a finite field
column5: The irreducible characters of GL_n(F_q) constructed by J. A. Green (1955), parametrised by conjugacy classes of data from characters of extension fields; here 'labels' (monic squarefree polynomials of degree r with nonzero constant term) name characters attached to regular semisimple classes, each with a central idempotent of the group algebra.
column6: general linear group; character of a representation; finite field

column5: An idempotent e (e^2 = e) of a ring that commutes with all elements. In C[G] a central idempotent has a class function as coefficient function.
column6: idempotent element; center of a ring

column5: For a number field E of degree n with discriminant D_E, the number |D_E|^(1/n).
For a commutative ring R and finite index set n, the group GL_n(R) of invertible n x n matrices over R. (The existing corpus knowl is the Lie group version; a ring-theoretic knowl may be needed.)
column6: matrix ring; unit of a ring

column5: A number field all of whose complex embeddings have real image.
For an extension E/K of number fields, the ideal of O_E whose inverse is the dual of O_E under the trace form Tr_{E/K}; an element x with x*D^{-1} integral has integral trace.
column6: ring of integers of a number field; trace of a field extension

column5: Form used: for the standard definite unitary group over E, a prime p and finite adelic points g, d, there is a rational point gamma such that gamma*g and d*(gamma*g)*d^{-1} are integral at all places above p.
column6: unitary group of a hermitian space; finite adele ring of a number field

column1: sphere packing bound for separated sets
column5: If points x_i of a Euclidean space of dimension n are pairwise at distance at least 1, then the sum of exp(-D |x_i|) converges for D > n and is bounded explicitly (here by 3^n e^n for D = n + 1).

A lattice L in a hermitian space equal to its dual under the form; over the integral finite adeles of a CM field unramified over its totally real subfield at all finite places, a unimodular lattice has an orthonormal basis.
column6: hermitian space over a CM field; dual lattice

column5: A Taylor coefficient of an entire function is bounded by the supremum of the function on a polydisc divided by the corresponding power of the radii; here in the Gaussian-integral (Fock space) form: P(d)F(0) is the integral of conj-P times F against the Gaussian measure.
